fusion_ranked_evidence.title: Indranil Sen - Wikipedia
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: | Minister of Tourism of West Bengal "Department of Tourism (West Bengal)") |. **Indranil Sen** is an Indian politician, Bengali artist, actor, and film producer from West Bengal. He is former minister of state of the Tourism Department and MoS (I/C) of the Technical Education, Training & Skill Development Department under the Government of West Bengal since September 2023. He was a member of the West Bengal Legislative Assembly from the Chandannagar Assembly constituency from 2016 to 2026 on the symbol of Trinamool Congress, a party led by Mamata Banerjee. Although he is primarily a singer of Indian Bengali songs, he is renowned for his work in modern Bengali music, Rabindra Sangeet, and folk songs. Indranil Sen was born on 3 June 1965 in Kolkata, West Bengal to Prodyut Kumar Sen. He has completed his senior secondary from the New Alipore Multipurpose School, Kolkata affiliated under West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education in 1983 and Diploma in Aircraft Maintenance Engineering from the Hindustan Institute of Engineering Technology, Chennai in 1986.
